name: bto-hr
description: Create BTO Word CVs, rank candidates against job descriptions, and organise Trello Talent Pool cards.

interface.shortDescription: BTO CVs, candidate scoring and Trello talent cards.
defaultPrompt: Convert the attached original CV into an editable BTO Word document in English, preserving wording except for necessary translation and cleanup.
Create a fictional BTO Word CV to test the formatting and native bullet lists.
Use $score to rank the attached CVs against each job description and update my configured shared Excel shortlist for candidates scoring at least 80/100.
Use $trello to create or update Talent Pool cards from the attached CVs, without uploading files.
interface.longDescription: Create an editable .docx using the BTO reference banner, Century Gothic fonts, measured spacing and native square bullet lists. Preserves supplied facts. Includes a deterministic Word generator and optional HTML preview. Includes Score for JD-specific candidate rankings, language flags and shared Excel shortlists. Includes Trello Talent Pool card creation, role classification, seniority labels and opportunity copies, without file uploads.
